3. Claimant-injured is before this Court being aggrieved by the judgment and award dated 03.02.2022 passed in MVC No.628/2017 on the file of the Senior Civil Judge and Addl. MACT,
Basavakalyan at Basavakalyan, ('Tribunal') to a very limited extent that the Tribunal while granting the compensation of Rs.6,36,560/- has awarded the interest at 6% per annum from the date of judgment till realization, instead of from the date of petition till realization.

4. Learned counsel for the appellant Sri Sharanabasappa K. Babshetty, submits that the only grievance of the appellant is that the Tribunal ought to have awarded interest from the date of Kadambari vs Neeta Verma And Anr on 18 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/78053130/
